framework.name: fastapi
framework.notes: Python API framework (not a JS meta-framework). Frontend is a separate Vite SPA: React 19.2 + TanStack Router 1.170 (file-based routes) + TanStack Query. Backend serves the built SPA itself via FastAPI's new app.frontend("/", directory=...) helper; openapi_url=/api/v1/openapi.json with custom_generate_unique_id for SDK generation.

node_or_python_requirement: Python >=3.14,<4.0 (.python-version=3.14); Bun 1.x (CI pins bun 1.3.12; no engines field in frontend/package.json)

workspaces: backend (uv workspace member declared in root pyproject.toml)
monorepo.notes: Dual-package-manager monorepo: JS side uses bun workspaces (bun.lock at root), Python side uses a uv workspace (uv.lock at root, [tool.uv.workspace] members = ["backend"]). Root scripts are bun --filter wrappers (dev/lint/test/email:dev/email:export).

auth.notes: Hand-rolled JWT auth: pyjwt HS256 access tokens (ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES default 60*24*8 = 8 days) issued by POST /login/access-token, OAuth2PasswordBearer in backend/app/api/deps.py, password hashing via pwdlib with Argon2Hasher+BcryptHasher (argon2 preferred, bcrypt legacy support via verify_and_update). Admin = User.is_superuser boolean (no roles table, no RBAC beyond is_superuser). Password recovery emails a JWT reset token (EMAIL_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS=48). No social/OAuth login, no MFA, no email verification on signup (signup is open, creates is_active=True user).

required_at_build: DATABASE_URL (all five are non-defaulted in backend/app/core/config.py Settings and are read at import time; a missing one breaks any `uv run` command), VITE_API_URL
env.notes: 21 backend vars (backend/app/core/config.py Settings + committed root .env), 2 frontend vars (frontend/.env: VITE_API_URL, MAILPIT_HOST), 1 compose-deploy var (DOMAIN), 2 CI-only deploy secrets in .github/workflows/deploy.yml. No values recorded. DATABASE_URL is rewritten to postgresql+psycopg:// automatically. The repo COMMITS a root .env whose SECRET_KEY/FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_PASSWORD are the literal placeholder 'changethis' (checked by grep, not printed); .fastapicloudignore excludes .env from the FastAPI Cloud build. Secrets are enforced at import: Settings._enforce_non_default_secrets raises ValueError for 'changethis' unless FASTAPI_ENV=development.

deploy.build_cmd: bun run --filter frontend build (root) / in Docker: backend/Dockerfile stage 1 runs `bun install` + `bun run build` in frontend, output lands in backend/app/frontend
deploy.start_cmd: backend image CMD: fastapi run --workers 4 ; compose.override dev command: fastapi dev --host 0.0.0.0
deploy.migrations_cmd: uv run bash scripts/prestart.sh (working dir backend/ or `docker compose run --rm backend bash scripts/prestart.sh`) -> alembic upgrade head && python app/initial_data.py
deploy.notes: Four deploy paths in-repo: (1) FastAPI Cloud via .github/workflows/deploy.yml (`fastapi deploy`, app dir = backend, .fastapicloudignore), (2) self-hosted Docker Compose via compose.yml + compose.deploy.yml with Traefik v3.7 + Let's Encrypt TLS (docker.sock mounted, requires DOMAIN var), (3) local full-stack `docker compose watch` with live sync + Mailpit, (4) plain local dev (uv + bun). No EXPOSE line in backend/Dockerfile; the port 8000 is set by Traefik labels and the healthcheck. No separate frontend production image (Playwright-only frontend/Dockerfile.playwright). standalone_output is a Next.js concept and is not applicable -> false.

tests.notes: Backend: pytest 5 test modules (tests/api/routes/test_{items,login,private,users}.py + tests/crud/test_user.py) plus conftest.py and tests/utils; CI enforces `coverage report --fail-under=90` and uploads smokeshow HTML coverage. Frontend: Playwright only (6 spec files + tests/auth.setup.ts storage-state project, chromium/firefox/webkit projects) — no vitest/jest unit layer, so there is no frontend unit test safety net. E2E specs drive the real stack through Mailpit (frontend/tests/utils/mailpit.ts) for password-reset tokens. Lint/type CI: ruff+mypy+ty (backend), biome (frontend), pre-commit with zizmor. CI needs Docker (db + mailpit) and `scripts/prestart.sh` before tests.

vendor.name: fastapi-cloud
vendor.what_it_does: Hosted deploy target plus the `fastapi deploy` / `fastapi cloud setup-ci` CLI
vendor.swap_target_hint: any Docker host (Fly.io / Railway / Render / plain VPS + compose.deploy.yml)

vendor.name: sentry
vendor.what_it_does: Error tracking + tracing, initialised only when SENTRY_DSN set and FASTAPI_ENV != development
vendor.swap_target_hint: GlitchTip (self-hosted, Sentry-compatible) or drop the 2 lines

vendor.name: smtp-provider
vendor.what_it_does: Transactional email delivery (password recovery, new-account, test email) through a generic SMTP relay
vendor.swap_target_hint: provider-agnostic already: point at Resend/SES/Mailgun SMTP, or swap the `emails`+jinja2 send_email() for an API SDK

vendor.name: mailpit
vendor.what_it_does: Local/test SMTP catcher (axllent/mailpit) the Playwright suite reads tokens from
vendor.swap_target_hint: Mailpit is OSS and dev-only; a real relay in prod or MailHog

vendor.name: traefik
vendor.what_it_does: Reverse proxy + automatic HTTPS for the self-hosted compose deploy
vendor.swap_target_hint: Caddy or nginx-proxy; or skip if you only use FastAPI Cloud

vendor.name: neon/supabase
vendor.what_it_does: Managed Postgres integrations that inject DATABASE_URL for the FastAPI Cloud deploy (docs only, no code coupling)
vendor.swap_target_hint: any Postgres 14+ (compose ships postgres:18); DATABASE_URL is the only interface

pitfalls.detail: settings = Settings() runs at import and SECRET_KEY, PROJECT_NAME, DATABASE_URL, FIRST_SUPERUSER, FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD have no defaults; additionally any value equal to 'changethis' raises ValueError unless FASTAPI_ENV=development. So `pytest`/`alembic`/`fastapi dev` all fail before doing anything until a real .env exists one directory above backend/.

Requires Python >=3.14 (bleeding edge). .python-version pins 3.14 and the Docker image is python:3.14; a dev box with 3.11/3.12 must build a new interpreter (uv python install 3.14) before `uv sync` works.

Frontend build output goes to ../backend/app/frontend and is served by FastAPI (app.frontend in backend/app/main.py). There is no standalone frontend deploy: forgetting `bun run build` after frontend edits means FastAPI keeps serving a stale SPA, and git-ignores backend/app/frontend/ so the artifact is invisible in git.
Backend wheels are compiled/native: psycopg[binary], pwdlib[argon2,bcrypt] (argon2-cffi + bcrypt), and Python 3.14 wheels are required — no pure-Python fallback.

Very fresh major versions across the JS stack (React 19.2, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Tailwind 4 via @tailwindcss/vite, Biome 2, @hey-api/openapi-ts 0.97, @vitejs/plugin-react-swc 4, TanStack Router 1.170). Adding older plugins/components (eslint, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, framer-motion-era code, tailwind 3 configs) will fight these; the repo also moved from ESLint to Biome and from CRACO/react-scripts to Vite, so most blog snippets for this template no longer apply.

The deploy workflow is deliberately inert on the template itself: deploy.yml has `if: github.repository != 'fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template'`, so pushing to a fresh copy of the repo shows a green/no-op Deploy run that silently does nothing until repo vars/secrets (DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY, FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD, PROJECT_NAME, FIRST_SUPERUSER, FASTAPI_CLOUD_TOKEN, FASTAPI_CLOUD_APP_ID) are configured.

Two root-level leftovers that mislead: frontend/index.html still references /vite.svg (not present in frontend/public), and root .gitignore ignores only .vscode/node_modules/build artifacts — there is no .env ignore entry, so the committed root .env (placeholder 'changethis' secrets) stays in git history.

Playwright e2e requires downloaded browsers plus a running backend, Postgres and Mailpit; the suite's auth.setup + reset-password specs read one-time tokens from the Mailpit HTTP API, so tests fail confusingly when mailpit is not up. Local runs want `docker compose up -d db mailpit` first, and `bun ci`/`bun install` needs bun, not npm/yarn.

Two email code paths must stay in sync: React Email sources in packages/react-email/emails/*.tsx are exported to backend/app/email-templates/*.html via `bun run email:export`, and the backend renders those committed HTML files with jinja2. Editing the .tsx alone changes nothing at runtime.

Self-hosted compose deploy mounts /var/run/docker.sock into Traefik (root-equivalent host access) and needs a real DOMAIN var or compose.deploy.yml aborts; on Windows/macOS Docker Desktop the `develop.watch` live-sync workflow is the only smooth local path.

Older, widely-copied versions of this template used cookiecutter, PostgreSQL 'items' + a Next/CRA frontend, but master is now a non-cookiecutter bun+uv repo — treat any pre-0.11 tutorial (cookiecutter flags, `{{cookiecutter.project_slug}}`, GitHub Actions secrets generation) as wrong.

verdict.best_for: A Python-team SaaS starter that already ships production-shaped plumbing — JWT auth with password recovery, admin user management, Postgres+SQLModel+Alembic migrations, typed auto-generated TS client, pytest+Playwright CI and Docker/Traefik deploy — so a new API+SPA product can start from login/admin/migrations on day one.
verdict.weak_for: Anything needing multi-tenancy, teams/orgs, billing, i18n/RTL, file uploads, background jobs or a real Next.js/SSR frontend — none of those exist here, and the only domain model is a placeholder Item; it is also pinned to Python 3.14 and bleeding-edge JS majors.
verdict.swap_burden: medium — auth is hand-rolled JWT (no library to rip out, but no OAuth/orgs either), the SwiftUI-free stack is otherwise standard; the real work is deleting the Item demo domain, rewriting the FastAPI-Cloud/Traefik deploy glue, and re-exporting the React Email templates after any copy change.

unmeasured: Hand-written LOC is an estimate (~11.0k), not a measured count: cloning is forbidden by the contract, so it is derived from git-trees blob byte sizes divided by a 29.2 bytes-per-line ratio sampled from 14 source files.
Test health is unknown: tests were never run (no clone/allowed execution), so pass/fail state, actual coverage % and Playwright flakiness are unverified.

Runtime/build behaviour unverified: no `uv sync`, `bun install`, `bun run build` or `docker compose up` was executed, so dependency-resolution success on Python 3.14, any peer-conflict warnings and image build time are unmeasured.
Whether packages/react-email `email:export` output currently matches the committed backend/app/email-templates/*.html byte-for-byte was not checked (would require running the tool).

Routes are taken from files/decorators, not from a running app: the live OpenAPI document (/api/v1/openapi.json) was not fetched, and framework-level defaults (404 handler, trailing-slash redirects) are not enumerated.
Only the master branch was inspected; the 6 other branches (dependabot bumps, fix-backend-reload-during-playwright-tests) were not read, so unreleased changes are outside this snapshot.
Frontend bundle size, Core Web Vitals, dark-mode/a11y quality and mobile behaviour were not measured (no browser run against the app).
Binary/asset content (img/*.png screenshots, favicon, SVG logos) was not inspected, so visual-branding effort is judged from filenames and import sites only.
Docker Hub / npm / PyPI download and licence-pricing data for the vendors (Sentry tiers, FastAPI Cloud pricing) was not queried; effort_guess values are engineering estimates, not measured.

Contributor metrics come from the contributors API which counts default-branch commits only and includes bots; issue search counts are capped at the search API's pagination, so historical totals are approximate.
